wiki.title: Samara Heavrin
wiki.extract: Samara Rae Heavrin (born March 12, 1992) is an American politician and Republican member of the Kentucky House of Representatives. She represents Kentucky's 18th House district, which includes Grayson County as well as part of Hardin County.
